title: Cad Shape Mesh With Coplanar Merge
description: The lowpoly default mesh (Concrete Forest Left, derived from CAD hexagonal-cut-concrete-forest-left) has wrong filled faces — large triangles spanning open space between vertical supports that are not part of the CAD solid. Root cause is likely fill_holes() during CAD→lowpoly regeneration incorrectly capping boundary loops between legs. Fix so the lowpoly mesh is the true mesh of the CAD shape without spurious filled faces.
summary: Discarded the previous lowpoly mesh and rebuilt from CAD B-Rep face wires, then merged all coplanar faces. Pipeline: solid_face_loops → from_face_loops → orient_faces_consistently → merge_coplanar_faces (no fill_holes). Result: 71 verts / 50 faces, plate sides merged into 16-gons, top plate one quad, 0 spanning/fused column webs. Regenerated concrete-forest-left.mesh.json and default.lowpoly.json. Verified lowpoly_core tests and rebuilt lowpoly-plugin wasm.
